I asked him to come in. ‘No, I cannot stay; I have only brought you a little parcel my sisters left for you. I think it contains a colourbox, pencils, and paper.’ I approached to take it: a welcome gift it was. He examined my face, I thought, with austerity, as I came near: the traces of tears were doubtless very visible upon it. ‘Have you found your first day’s work harder than you expected?’ he asked. ‘Oh, no!
